title: GTA VI: Why the 13-year wait could be worth $8 billion
summary: After more than 13 years, Grand Theft Auto VI finally launches on November 19, and it's about a lot more than a video game. Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian follows the money: why Take-Two is telling investors to expect $8 billion-plus in bookings this year but only about $109 million to $142 million in profit, how GTA Online's recurring spending became the real prize, and why Sony and Microsoft can cash in without making the game at all.

title: Peter Thiel Now Has as Much Money in an Argentine Oil Stock as in Amazon. It’s Down 23% Since September 30
summary: Peter Thiel's hedge fund bought 697,043 more shares of Vista Energy last quarter, and on September 30 its $123.3 million stake in the Argentine shale driller matched its $123.3 million in Amazon to within $24,583. Brent crude has fallen 25% from its October 30 price since, and Vista 23% since September 30. Here is what Vista is and why an investor might bet on Vaca Muerta.

title: Is Your VOO Fund Secretly An AI Bet?
summary: Most people treat an S&P 500 index fund as the safe default. The AI sell-off reads like a tech-stock story that index owners can watch from the side. The fund's own holdings say otherwise. About one dollar in four in the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) sits in six AI giants.

title: Anthropic’s Margins Will Be “Probably Better Than a Hyperscaler,” Says Its Most Bullish Analyst. Here’s What That Takes

title: NYC lawmakers weigh compromise on Amazon delivery worker bill, Bloomberg reports
summary: Investing.com -- New York City lawmakers are weighing substantial revisions to proposed legislation that would force Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN) to directly employ thousands of outsourced delivery drivers, according to a Bloomberg report. The potential overhaul signals a strategic compromise in a high-stakes regulatory battle pitting the e-commerce giant against Mayor Zohran Mamdani and a City Council majority.
